Main text in one column, with a two-column diagram (left: Ex prima figurâ, right: Ex secundâ figurâ) inside the text block, followed by more running text. p.i: Hæc est tertia figura apud Lullium; quæ composita est ex primâ & secundâ. Prima complectitur prædicata absoluta, secunda respectiva. Itaq; B. in hac figurâ significat prædicata figuræ primæ & secundæ: & sic de aliis literis. Ipsa autem figura con-tinet cameras XXXVI. Qualibet camera habet multa & diversa significata per duas literas in eâ conten-tas. Duæ istæ literæ significant subjectum & prædi-catum. Sic v. g. B. significat subjectum, quod est Bonitas. Huic subjecto attribuuntur reliquæ literæ, ut patet in schemate. Exemplum habe illud. Bonita-tem constitue subjectum, reliqua autem principia sunto loco prædicati.
Sicut Bonitas deducta est: ita & reliqua dedu-cuntur principia.
Usus hujus talis dispositionis est, ut intellectus

page.notes: The diagram's left-hand "Magna" is written in a stylised, flourished M. The brace before "Bonitas est" in both columns is drawn as a single bracket. The printed "Itaq;" is read as written. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. The marginal note's hyphenation is kept as printed across its three lines. The page is set in italic throughout.
